name: Shingu
text: Shingū (新宮市, Shingū-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ɕiŋ.ɡɯꜜː(.ɕi), -ŋɯꜜː-]) is a city located in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 November 2021, the city had an estimated population of 27,491 in 14649 households and a population density of 110 persons per km2. The total area of the city is 255.23 square kilometres (98.54 sq mi).

depictions.name: Shingu
depictions.text: Shingū, Wakayama Shingū (新宮市) is a city in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was located in the eastern part of Kii Province.
